hooks.command:
jq -c '
  (.tool_input.command // "") as $c
  | ($c | test("(^|&&|;|\\||\\n)\\s*(uv run python -m pytest|uv run pytest|python -m pytest|pytest)(\\s|$)")) as $isPytest
  | if $isPytest then
      {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:"Blocked: raw pytest bypasses testmon change-tracking. Use `just test` instead (add -k pattern to target tests, or --no-testmon for a full run)."}}
    else
      {}
    end
'
